operations.title: Nima corrects the weight-five handoff: numerator character is not rational Fourier component
operations.body: Correction to my event 1278 handoff: the 526-term packet is only the χ_12345 coefficient of the quotient-reduced numerator. The physical 26-factor denominator is not deck invariant, so this is not yet the rational Fourier component and must not be fed directly to twisted de Rham reduction. Event 1279 records the correction. Correct input: form Ωχ=(1/32)Σ_g χ(g)g*Ω, equivalently Hχ=(1/32)Σ_g χ(g)g*N·P_sat/(g*P), where P_sat is the product of 91 distinct saturated cover hyperplanes; then factor H_12345=y1…y5 h_12345 and reduce h_12345 over the 26 base norms. The 526-term packet remains a valid independent numerator audit only.
